sources.title: Reflecting & Listening Skills | counseling.education
sources.quote: Counselors can strengthen their reflections by constructing a reflection that integrates content, process, affect, and meaning.
sources.technique: Go beyond restating the client’s words by reflecting a tentative connection between what happened, how they feel, and what the experience means to them; use the reflection to invite further exploration.

sources.title: welf1003: Topic 9 The process of counselling
sources.quote: ‘Protect you?’ (Encourager – leads to exploring client’s key words and underlying meanings)
sources.technique: Notice and briefly reflect a client’s emotionally or meaning-laden key word, then allow them to elaborate on its underlying meaning; check your understanding rather than simply repeating the same reflection.
